path.description: Path to the diff file to review

reviewer_guidelines.description: Shared risk level definitions and finding format used by both specialists

review_security.description: Identify security vulnerabilities in the diff. Produces findings[], risk_level, and confidence. Schema-enforced before synthesize_review starts — the synthesizer cannot receive a malformed security review.
review_security.prompt:
You are a security specialist reviewing a code diff.

Review standards:
{{ workflow.context.reviewer_guidelines }}

Diff to review:
{{ context.resources.read_diff.content }}

Required fields:
- findings: list of security issues found (each entry: function/location + one-sentence issue)
  If no issues are found, return an empty list.
- risk_level: overall security risk ('low', 'medium', 'high', or 'critical')
- confidence: your confidence in this assessment as a decimal between 0.0 and 1.0

Return exactly these three fields. Any missing or invalid field will be rejected.

review_performance.description: Identify performance problems in the diff. Produces findings[], risk_level, and confidence. Schema-enforced before synthesize_review starts — the synthesizer cannot receive a malformed performance review.
review_performance.prompt:
You are a performance specialist reviewing a code diff.

Review standards:
{{ workflow.context.reviewer_guidelines }}

Diff to review:
{{ context.resources.read_diff.content }}

Required fields:
- findings: list of performance issues found (each entry: function/location + one-sentence issue)
  If no issues are found, return an empty list.
- risk_level: overall performance risk ('low', 'medium', 'high', or 'critical')
- confidence: your confidence in this assessment as a decimal between 0.0 and 1.0

Return exactly these three fields. Any missing or invalid field will be rejected.

synthesize_review.description: Combine the security and performance reviews into a single structured verdict. Both upstream reviews are already schema-validated — the synthesizer receives confirmed, structured data from both branches.

record_review.description: Mark the review complete. All findings are already in the evidence chain from review_security, review_performance, and synthesize_review — this step exists to give the workflow a clean terminal step distinct from the final agent step.
